offers.conditions: The Managed Agents page lists a Free Trial with a $5 credit. Its footnote limits the trial to new DigitalOcean customers; existing customers can start on a paid plan. Use the official Start trial link. This is a Managed Agents offer, not a verified general-purpose Droplet coupon.

terms.conditions: This is the starting price printed on the general pricing page, not a promotional discount. The selected configuration determines the price.

terms.offer: Managed Agents trial-credit expiry: not published
terms.conditions: The Managed Agents trial section checked did not publish a credit-expiry date or duration. An unpublished date does not mean permanent validity. The general pricing FAQ uses a 90-day credit as an example; we do not assign that example to this trial.

terms.offer: Charges after credit is used or expires
terms.conditions: The general pricing FAQ says the card is charged after free credit has been used or after its expiration period. Check the offer and billing details on your own account before using paid resources.

The official billing documentation says billing starts at creation and ends when the Droplet is destroyed; powered-off bundled CPU Droplets are still billed. Associated snapshots, volumes and volume snapshots are not destroyed by default, so review them separately.

The pricing FAQ says DigitalOcean is required to apply taxes in some countries and links to its country-specific tax documentation. Do not assume the displayed starting price is the final invoice total.

The pricing FAQ says refunds are not offered and directs users with extenuating circumstances to support. Section 12 of the Terms says paid fees are non-refundable except as otherwise provided there or expressly agreed; outstanding fees become due on termination.
